hero.subheadline: A self service music machine for modern bars. Guests choose songs, pay directly on the machine. 25,000+ tracks. Zero hassle.

intro.tag: Self service karaoke & jukebox for bars
intro.descriptor1: SVANDA is a self service karaoke & jukebox machine built for bars, clubs, and events.
intro.descriptor2: Your guests walk up, browse 18,000+ songs, pay at the card terminal, grab the mic, and perform, all without a DJ or any staff involved. The machine handles the queue, the display, and the payments completely on its own, around the clock.

statement.w6: ANY BAR.  ANY NIGHT.  ANY SONG.

catalogue.descriptor1: The biggest karaoke catalogue for self service venues.
catalogue.descriptor2: Czech, Slovak, international hits. Every genre, every decade.
catalogue.note: Payment via card terminal · 10 CZK per song

howItWorks.step2Detail: Pick any song from 18,000+. Pay at the card terminal.

modes.descLeftDesc: Guests sing live on stage with full lyrics on screen. Pay per song at the terminal.
modes.descRightDesc: Queue up songs for background music. Perfect for bar ambience without a DJ.

benefits.desc: The machine handles payments, song queue, and display, completely autonomously. You gain a new revenue stream with zero operational overhead.

lemon.detail2: No staff. No downtime. Pure revenue.

experience.subDesc2: Get SVANDA for your bar, club, or next event.
